entities.summary: Maria Elisa Mendes Ticon Antonelli is a Brazilian beach volleyball player. She competed with Talita Antunes at the 2012 Summer Olympics, qualifying from group E before losing to the Czech team of Kristýna Kolocová and Markéta Sluková in the last 16.
